parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id,
  l.whatsapp_name,
  l.phone_number,
  l.service,
  l.city,
  l.requirement,
  l.channel,
  l.source_number_id,
  s.id AS seller_id,
  s.name AS seller_name,
  s.clickup_user_id,
  s.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT string_agg(
        CONCAT(
          to_char(COALESCE(m.external_timestamp, m.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
          ' ',
          CASE WHEN m.direction = 'incoming' THEN 'Cliente' ELSE 'Bot' END,
          ': ',
          COALESCE(m.text_body, CONCAT('[', m.message_type, ']'))
        ),
        E'\n'
        ORDER BY COALESCE(m.external_timestamp, m.created_at)
      )
      FROM messages m
      WHERE m.lead_id = l.id
        AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    ),
    ''
  ) AS full_conversation,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'attachment_id', ma.id,
          'attachment_type', ma.attachment_type,
          'mime_type', ma.mime_type,
          'filename', ma.filename,
          'external_media_id', ma.external_media_id,
          'external_url', ma.external_url,
          'file_size', ma.file_size
        )
      )
      FROM message_attachments ma
      JOIN messages m ON m.id = ma.message_id
      WHERE m.lead_id = l.id
        AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS attachments_json
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = l.assigned_seller_id
WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
  AND l.deleted_at IS NULL;

WITH updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    clickup_task_id = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), l.clickup_task_id) ELSE l.clickup_task_id END,
    clickup_task_url = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''), l.clickup_task_url) ELSE l.clickup_task_url END,
    lead_status_id = ls.id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM lead_statuses ls
  WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
    AND ls.code = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'created_in_clickup' ELSE 'error' END
  RETURNING l.id, l.clickup_task_id, l.clickup_task_url
),
audit_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (
    event_name,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    result,
    before_payload,
    after_payload,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    $5::text,
    'lead',
    ul.id,
    'system',
    'n8n',
    $6::text,
    '{}'::jsonb,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($8::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM updated_lead ul
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  ul.id AS lead_id,
  ul.clickup_task_id,
  ul.clickup_task_url,
  ai.id AS audit_id
FROM updated_lead ul
LEFT JOIN audit_insert ai ON TRUE;
